resources.string: GPS Idle: Ready to set destination

Choose your destination
Search or move the map until the pin marks your stop. Confirm the location, give it a name and optionally save it. Back returns without changing your destination.

Before you travel
Choose English, Tamil or Hindi, then tap Start Destination Alarm. Keep location enabled and allow notifications. Saved locations start an alarm when tapped. Stop the current trip before choosing another destination.

Progressive alerts (Bus / Car)
5 km: gentle chime and vibration.
2 km: stronger vibration and attention pings.
1 km: spoken destination reminder.
0.5 km: continuous wake-up alarm and vibration. You are nearby, not necessarily at your stop.

Alerts can skip stages when you start close to your destination. Distances are straight-line GPS estimates. Tap Stop or dismiss the alarm to silence it.

Voice & sound
Speech uses voice data installed on your phone, with English as a fallback. Check alarm volume and Do Not Disturb settings before travel. Map search needs internet; tracking uses GPS.
